references.text: The context for redeeming a field that has been dedicated to the Lord, where its value is calculated based on how many years remain until the Year of Jubilee.
Describes the consequence of not redeeming the field: it becomes holy to the Lord in the Year of Jubilee as the priest's property.
Basic laws concerning the redemption of land and the principle that the land belongs to the Lord, which provide the background for rules about selling and redeeming.
The Year of Jubilee when all land must return to its original owner, which is the central principle behind the redemption regulations.
A reference to the Year of Jubilee and the transfer of property, showing how inheritance rights and property transfers function in Israel.
A prophetic warning that the buyer shall not return to what has been sold, reflecting the principle of irrevocable sale.
